title: querylog.py export names its fields as OTLP-JSON and keeps one flat event namespace
goal: querylog.py export prints each record with OTLP-JSON field names (timeUnixNano, severityText, body, attributes, resource attributes service.name and kb.run) and one flat event namespace instead of entry.<surface>, finding.<kind>, usage, work.<kind> and ops.<event>, with a test named ops_export_otlp_names that plants one store row and one ops row and asserts the names. Operator decision on ST-xsxyq4wi g1; the landed snake_case shape is replaced, not kept beside it.

gates.question: Flat event names and value mapping of the OTLP-JSON export: family and surface/kind joined by underscores (entry_prompt, ops_land_step), the original type in kb.record and kb.type attributes, severity numbers INFO 9 and WARN 13, body the empty AnyValue, intValue as a decimal string?
options: underscore-joined names with kb.record and kb.type attributes
dotted-free names without family prefix where unique
gates.recommendation: underscore-joined names with kb.record and kb.type attributes
gates.answer: underscore-joined names with kb.record and kb.type attributes
